newsitem.title: USA: Four USDA nominees approved, sent to Senate floor.
newsitem.headline: Four USDA nominees approved, sent to Senate floor.

text.p: The U.S. Senate Agriculture Committee approved Wednesday four nominations to fill undersecretary posts at the Agriculture Department, and sent the nominations to the floor for a vote.

Approved were Gus Schumacher to be undersecretary for farm and foreign agricultural programs, Shirley Watkins for undersecretary for public nutrition, Miley Gonzalez for research undersecretary and Catherine Woteki for food safety undersecretary.
Chairman Richard Lugar, R-Ind., said he hoped for a floor vote before the end of the week.
